name: anythingmcp
description: Self-hosted MCP gateway and company brain for AI agents: connect Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot to your ERP, APIs, databases and file servers, with company memory, skills, knowledge graph, SSO/RBAC and audit. 691 connectors (SAP, Odoo, SQL…). Open source, EU cloud.

capability_evidence.billing-metering: es documents, A/P invoices, payments, journal entries, chart of accounts, bank reconciliations; create sales orders
capability_evidence.memory-context: Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot and Gemini to the software your company runs and to the documents on your file servers, without writing an MCP server.
capability_evidence.mcp-support: AnythingMCP: the open-source MCP gateway that becomes your company brain
capability_evidence.self-hosted: AnythingMCP: the open-source MCP gateway that becomes your company brain

friction.note_en: Some setup. needs docker compose up; configure API key configuration, OAuth login flow; no-code positioning
friction.note_zh: 需要一些配置。需要 docker compose up；需配置 API key configuration、OAuth login flow；no-code positioning

analysis.summary_en: On top of the gateway it keeps your company brain: a knowledge graph of how your systems connect, AI skills and company memory, shared by every AI client and limited by each user's role.
highlights: Every auth scheme you will meet.
Copilot, Gemini, Cursor and other MCP clients: client setup guides.
Claude. Add the server URL as a custom connector under Customize → Connectors; it then works in Claude.ai, Claude Desktop and Claude Code. OAuth 2.0 is supported out of the box. On Anything…
Hand one URL to your AI client.
analysis.summary_zh_native: 在网关之上，它还为你维护企业大脑：一张描述各系统如何关联的知识图谱、AI 技能和企业记忆，由所有 AI 客户端共享，并按每个用户的角色限制访问。
highlights_zh: 支持你会遇到的各种认证方式。 OAuth2（PKCE 和 Client Credentials）、Bearer、API Key、Basic、HMAC 请求签名、LOGIN_TOKEN 和 OAuth 1.0a。凭据以 AES-256-GCM 加密存储。
响应映射。 每个工具都声明哪些字段可以到达模型：删除客户的 IBAN 或员工的薪资，或者只列出要保留的字段。编辑器会基于真实响应显示前后对比；某个内置适配器从 12,172 B 减少到 1,072 B（−91%），这些字段也就不再占用上下文窗口。映射出错时默认返回原始响应；对于字段绝不能外传的工具，请设置 "fallbackToRaw": false，此时调用会直接失败。
AI 技能。 把反复出现的使用方式变成简短规则（例如"今日营收包含订单状态 2、3 和 4"）和分步操作流程。技能可以手动编写，也可以从真实请求和已修复的错误中学习，带有版本记录，经管理员批准后才会写入服务器的指令中。
把一个 URL 交给 AI 客户端。 MCP 服务器就是你添加到 Claude、ChatGPT、Copilot、Gemini 或 Cursor 中的端点。它只公开分配给它的连接器。
